header.title: Rescue of Princess Jennifer
header.author: RobOS AI Studio
header.description: The sinister Dark Lord Malakor has abducted Princess Jennifer into his subterranean lair. King Alden commands Sir Caleb to claim the Hero's Sword from the Dragonclaw Forge, vanquish the Dark Lord, and bring the princess home.

campaign.dcterms:title: Rescue of Princess Jennifer
campaign.dcterms:description: The sinister Dark Lord Malakor has abducted Princess Jennifer into his subterranean lair. King Alden commands Sir Caleb to claim the Hero's Sword from the Dragonclaw Forge, vanquish the Dark Lord, and bring the princess home.

robos:startingSpawn.entryDescription: Sir Caleb kneels before King Alden upon the royal carpet in the Throne Room.

robos:mapConnections.label: Castle Gate to World Realm (Requires Hero's Sword)

robos:flowPages.name: Act I: Royal Decree & Dragonclaw Forge
robos:flowPages.summary: King Alden tasks Sir Caleb with rescuing Princess Jennifer, and Caleb proves his valor at the Dragonclaw Forge.

robos:flowPages.name: Act II: The Journey & Slaying Malakor
robos:flowPages.summary: Sir Caleb journeys across the World Realm, enters the Lair, and slays Dark Lord Malakor.

robos:flowPages.name: Act III: The Triumphant Return
robos:flowPages.summary: Princess Jennifer is safely returned to the Throne Room, achieving total campaign victory.

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: The King's Royal Decree
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: King Alden reveals that Princess Jennifer has been abducted by Dark Lord Malakor. He commands Sir Caleb to obtain the Hero's Sword from Master Torvald before entering the dungeon.

robos:choices.label: Accept King's decree and go to Dragonclaw Forge

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Master Torvald's Crucible
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Master Torvald at the Dragonclaw Forge requires proof of valor before yielding the rune-forged Hero's Sword. He conjures a Projection Goblin.

robos:choices.label: Draw steel and duel the astral projection

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Trial of the Projection Goblin
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Sir Caleb slays the weak Projection Goblin with ease. Master Torvald awards the legendary Hero's Sword and opens the castle gate.

robos:choices.label: Claim Hero's Sword and depart through the gate into the World

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Wilderness Trek to the Cavern Maw
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Equipped with the Hero's Sword, Sir Caleb journeys across the wilderness and crags of the World Realm, discovering the entrance to the Dark Lord's Lair.

robos:choices.label: Descend into the darkness to confront Dark Lord Malakor

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Slaying the Dark Lord
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Sir Caleb battles Dark Lord Malakor. The Hero's Sword shatters Malakor's shadow ward and slays the Dark Lord, liberating Princess Jennifer from her cage.

robos:choices.label: Unlock the gilded cage and escort Princess Jennifer home

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Victory: The Kingdom Celebrates
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Sir Caleb returns Princess Jennifer to King Alden in the Throne Room. King Alden declares Sir Caleb the Savior of the Realm, and victory is proclaimed across the land.
robos:storyNodes.robos:epilogueText: With Dark Lord Malakor vanquished and Princess Jennifer safely restored to the throne, the bells of the High Kingdom chime in celebration of Sir Caleb's valor.

npc-king-alden.robos:backstory: Ruler of the realm, grief-stricken by the kidnapping of his daughter Princess Jennifer.
npc-king-alden.backstory: Ruler of the realm, grief-stricken by the kidnapping of his daughter Princess Jennifer.
robos:dialogue: Sir Caleb! Darkness enshrouds our court. The sinister Dark Lord Malakor hath abducted Princess Jennifer into his subterranean lair!
Thou must venture forth, slay the Dark Lord, and bring my daughter home! But mortal iron cannot pierce his shadow armor.
Go first to the Dragonclaw Forge in the castle courtyard and speak with Master Torvald. Claim the Hero's Sword, then rid our realm of this evil!

npc-blacksmith-torvald.schema:name: Master Torvald
npc-blacksmith-torvald.name: Master Torvald
npc-blacksmith-torvald.robos:backstory: Legendary blacksmith of the Dragonclaw Forge, keeper of ancient rune weapons.
npc-blacksmith-torvald.backstory: Legendary blacksmith of the Dragonclaw Forge, keeper of ancient rune weapons.
robos:dialogue: Hail, Sir Caleb! The King's messenger informed me of the dire news. You seek the Hero's Sword from the Dragonclaw Forge.
The blade is forged and imbued with dragonfire runes, but I cannot place it in hands that tremble! Prove your battle mettle against my astral creation!
Behold, the Projection Goblin! Strike it down, and the Hero's Sword is yours!
